notes.text: Ludwig van Beethoven, Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2 ('Moonlight'), 1801, first movement, Adagio sostenuto. Public domain. Written alla breve; here as 4/4 at quarter = 54, so every beat is one triplet group. Three tracks by role: the triplets run the whole way; the melody enters on beat 4 of bar 5 with its dotted figure, and also takes the lower voice that answers it (bars 29, 31, 37–40); the bass is the left-hand octaves and held notes. The score asks for the sustain pedal throughout.

Starter song, annotated as demo content by Claude (2026-09-27) at Josh's request. Notes entered from the score (Durand 1915 urtext, bar numbering as in Henle); chord labels are the textbook readings, the notes on some bars say why.
